import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null && !line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(line.trim());
            runSolver(n, br);
        }
    }

    static void runSolver(int n, BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        String kLine = br.readLine();
        int k = Integer.parseInt(kLine.trim());

        double[] probs = new double[n];
        String[] probsStr = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            probs[i] = Double.parseDouble(probsStr[i]);
        }

        double[][] dp = new double[2][1 << n];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], 0.0);
        }

        boolean[] active = new boolean[n];
        List<Integer> indices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (probs[i] != 0) {
                active[i] = true;
                indices.add(i);
            }
        }

        dp[0][0] = 1.0;
        int flip = 1;

        double[] prefix = new double[1 << n];
        prefix[0] = 1.0;
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
            int pos = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(mask);
            prefix[mask] = prefix[mask ^ (1 << pos)] - probs[pos];
        }

        int limit = Math.min(indices.size(), k);
        for (int step = 0; step < limit; ++step) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[flip], 0.0);
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(mask) != step)
                    continue;
                for (int nxt : indices) {
                    if (((mask >> nxt) & 1) == 0) {
                        double denom = prefix[mask];
                        if (denom != 0) {
                            dp[flip][mask ^ (1 << nxt)] += dp[flip ^ 1][mask] * probs[nxt] / denom;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            flip ^= 1;
        }

        flip ^= 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (!active[i]) {
                System.out.printf("%.12f ", 0.0);
            } else {
                double total = 0.0;
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        total += dp[flip][mask];
                    }
                }
                System.out.printf("%.12f ", total);
            }
        }
        System.out.println();
    }
}
